Our experienced engineers, supervisors, skilled technicians and workforce work together to deliver projects with attention to quality, functionality and detail.
Work with a single team from initial design through execution and maintenance — no handoffs, no disconnects, one point of accountability.

sections.title: A Complete Design, Contracting & Maintenance Partner
paragraphs: Florel Core General Contracting and Interior Design LLC is a UAE-based company specializing in interior design, general contracting, renovation, civil works, MEP services, carpentry, fit-out and general maintenance.

Our team brings together experienced engineers, supervisors, technicians and skilled workers with practical experience in the UAE. We combine creative design thinking with technical execution to deliver functional, attractive and durable spaces.
We believe quality should be accessible. Our approach is to provide carefully planned, budget-conscious solutions while maintaining professional standards and attention to detail.
